summary.text: L. Scott Miller is an independent candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 88 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Republican Vanessa Grossl.
According to his campaign website, Miller is an attorney and a former Kentucky State Police trooper and lieutenant colonel.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, L. Scott Miller began his career as a Kentucky State Police trooper and rose to the rank of lieutenant colonel, and later practiced as an attorney.
The site describes him as a husband, father and grandfather, and lists faith, family, freedom, service, community and the rule of law among his stated values.
